preconditions.description: The integer N must be between 1 and 4 inclusive.
The integer K must be greater than 1 and less than 10.
The number of possible strings of size N with characters from 0 to K-1 must be less than 4096.

postconditions.description: The length of the output string S must be at least the number of possible strings of size N.

postconditions.expression: all(s in S for s in {str(i).zfill(N) for i in range(K**N)} if len(s) == N)
postconditions.description: The output string S must contain all possible strings of size N as substrings.
The output string S must not contain more unique characters than K.
